install_textless_package: install the textless package by running pip install in the project root directory
configure_textless_setup: configure the textless package metadata including name, version, author, and description in setup.py
manage_textless_dependencies: manage textless package dependencies by editing requirements.txt which is read by setup.py
discover_textless_packages: discover all subpackages in the textless project using setuptools find_packages function
review_textless_setup: review the textless setup.py to understand package metadata and dependency configuration
